
- `ffi/` — FFI bindings

=== Justfile Recipes

```bash
# Full build pipeline
just build              # Full: Idris2 → RefC → C → Zig FFI
just build-refc        # Step 1: Idris2 to RefC
just build-ffi         # Step 2: Zig FFI

# Type checking (no compilation)
just check file        # Single file
just check-core        # Core modules only (~24 modules)
just check-dev         # Dev build (no totality, faster)
just typecheck          # Full library WITH --total
just typecheck-ffi      # FFI-only package

# Verification
just verify-totality    # Totality checker on full library
just check-full         # Full verified build (CI/release only)

# Clean
just clean              # Clean build artifacts
```

=== Consumability

**proven is consumable as the Idris2 proof foundation** for:
- paint-type (ABI definitions)

**ABI surface:**

**Formal proofs:**

- No `believe_me` / `sorry` / `assert_total`
- REAL proofs (per source comments)

=== Verification Commands

```bash
# Type check the full library
pack typecheck proven.ipkg

# Type check the FFI package
pack typecheck proven-ffi.ipkg

# Run totality checker
idris2 --check --total proven.ipkg

# Build the full pipeline
just build
```
